name: WinGet-PSADT-GUI-Tool
description: WinGet-PSADT-GUI-Tool is a Windows PowerShell WPF GUI that streamlines Win32 app packaging and Intune deployment. It integrates WinGet search, installer download, PSADT scaffolding, and GUI-driven configuration of install/uninstall/repair logic, enabling generation of .intunewin packages and direct upload to Intune via Microsoft Graph. It outputs standard PSADT/Intune artifacts and provides live monitoring of packaging and upload steps.
author: Dhiraj Dhote

securityCheck.aiSummary: Code shows legitimate Intune/PSADT GUI tooling; primary security concern is the use of Base64-encoded PowerShell commands to invoke child processes, which can obscure payloads and bypass policy checks. No immediate credential theft, data exfiltration, or hardcoded secrets detected in the provided segments.

noObfuscatedCode.reason: Invoke-WindowsPowerShellCommand encodes the passed CommandText as Base64 and launches PowerShell with -EncodedCommand and -ExecutionPolicy Bypass. This enables obfuscated execution of arbitrary commands. If CommandText is derived from external input, it creates a risk of remote code execution or circumvention of policy checks.

noRemoteExecution.reason: The encoded invocation path (pwsh.exe -EncodedCommand) combined with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass can be exploited to execute injected payloads if inputs are not strictly validated. Recommend strict input validation, avoid bypassing policies unless necessary, and consider logging/alerting when decoded commands are produced.
